methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were fetched and re-verified for each vendor on 2026-06-19: mileiq.com/pricing, mileiq.com/pricing-for-business, everlance.com/pricing, triplog.net/pricing, triplog.net/pricing-multi-user, driversnote.com/pricing, hurdlr.com/pricing (the live page shows no dollar figures, so Premium/Pro prices were confirmed via Hurdlr University official help articles + Capterra), stridehealth.com/tax, and zoho.com/us/expense/pricing/. Zoho's official US page publishes per-month-billed-monthly ($43 Standard / $65 Premium) and the billed-annually per-month equivalents ($3 Standard / $5 Premium); the dataset uses the billed-annually equivalents and notes the monthly figures. monthlyUsd for annual-only plans is the effective per-month equivalent; annualDiscountPct is computed or sourced from published savings claims. Quote-only/enterprise tiers with no published price have monthlyUsd=null. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

vendors.name: MileIQ
vendors.provenance: Re-fetched mileiq.com/pricing and mileiq.com/pricing-for-business directly. Individual Unlimited confirmed at $13.99/month (monthly) and $11.66/month billed annually (~$139.92/year). Teams confirmed at $8 (Teams Lite), $9 (Teams), $10 (Teams Pro) per user/month, with $80/$90/$100 per user/year annual options. 30-day no-credit-card free trial applies to Teams Pro only.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 40 free drives per month (forever free, not a trial); automatic mileage tracking and auto-generated reports included.

plans.name: Unlimited (Monthly)
plans.notes: Unlimited drives; automatic tracking and reports. Billed monthly. No free trial on individual plans.

plans.name: Unlimited (Annual)
plans.notes: Displayed as '$11.66/month billed annually' (~$139.92/year). Saves ~17% vs $13.99 monthly. Unlimited drives.

plans.name: Teams Lite
plans.notes: $8/user/month (monthly) or $80/user/year (annual). Automatic tracking, add/remove drivers, streamlined billing. No reporting dashboard or drive approvals.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: $9/user/month or $90/user/year. Adds reporting dashboard over Teams Lite.

plans.name: Teams Pro
plans.notes: $10/user/month or $100/user/year. Full feature set: drive approval/rejection, commute exclusion, Team Locations, report reminders, multiple admin access, custom mileage rates. 30-day free trial, no credit card (Teams Pro only).

limits: 30-day free trial applies only to the Teams Pro business plan; individual plans have no trial
keyFeatures: Automatic GPS drive detection via phone motion sensors
Bundled with Microsoft 365 Business Standard/Premium subscriptions
enrichment.provenance: Pricing re-verified directly on mileiq.com/pricing and mileiq.com/pricing-for-business. Compliance certifications not stated on public pricing pages, so left null.

vendors.name: Everlance
vendors.provenance: Re-fetched everlance.com/pricing directly. Basic free (30 auto trips/month), Starter $8.99/month or $69.99/year, Professional $99.99/year (annual only). SOC 2 badge confirmed on the pricing page. The 7-day trial requires a credit card and auto-renews into the listed recurring prices (verified via help center); the dataset uses the real recurring prices, not the trial.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: 30 automatically detected trips/month, unlimited manual trips. Digital mileage log. No credit card required.

plans.name: Starter (Monthly)
plans.notes: Unlimited automatic mileage tracking. Expense tracking with receipt uploads, IRS-compliant reporting, customizable exports. Billed monthly. 7-day trial requires card and auto-renews to this price.

plans.name: Starter (Annual)
plans.notes: $69.99/year billed annually (~$5.83/month effective; ~35% vs $107.88/year at monthly rate). Unlimited automatic mileage tracking, expense tracking, IRS-compliant reports.

plans.name: Professional (Annual)
plans.notes: $99.99/year billed annually only (~$8.33/month effective; no monthly option). Adds automatic expense tracking, AI deduction finder, 1099 tax filing, $1M audit defense, live 1:1 training, priority support.

limits: Free plan limited to 30 auto-detected trips/month
7-day trial requires a credit card and auto-renews into the paid plan
enrichment.provenance: Re-fetched everlance.com/pricing directly. SOC 2 badge verified on pricing page. Professional confirmed annual-only at $99.99/year. 7-day trial confirmed to require a card and auto-renew (help center); recurring prices used, not trial teaser.

vendors.name: TripLog
vendors.provenance: Re-fetched triplog.net/pricing and triplog.net/pricing-multi-user directly. Single-user Premium confirmed at $4.99/month billed annually ($59.99/year). Multi-user mileage plans are genuinely published (not quote-only): Mileage Teams $8/user/month, Mileage Enterprise $12/user/month — corroborated by G2 and SpotSaaS.

plans.name: Basic (Free)
plans.notes: Unlimited automatic GPS mileage tracking, basic expense management, IRS-compliant reports, income/expense tracking, parking/tolls, fuel tracking, international support, cloud backup. No trip cap stated.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $4.99/month billed annually ($59.99/year). Adds unlimited reporting, OCR receipt capture, web app, auto-classification rules, bank/credit card integration, SAP Concur & QuickBooks Online connections, custom business activities. Includes one free 7-day Premium pass/year. Monthly-only billing not shown.

plans.name: Mileage Teams
plans.notes: $8/user/month (published on pricing-multi-user). Unlimited automatic tracking, approval management, real-time fleet tracking, integrations with SAP Concur, QuickBooks Online, Xero, ADP, Paychex.

plans.name: Mileage Enterprise
plans.notes: $12/user/month (published on pricing-multi-user). All Teams features plus advanced enterprise controls.

limits: Premium plan billed annually; standalone monthly option not published
Flex plan (per submitted report) pricing requires contacting support
keyFeatures: Unlimited GPS mileage tracking on free plan
Multiple tracking methods: phone GPS, Bluetooth beacon, OBD device
bestFor: Solo freelancers wanting a free unlimited tracker
enrichment.provenance: Re-fetched both pricing pages directly. Free plan confirmed as unlimited GPS tracking (no trip cap). Premium confirmed at $59.99/year annual billing. Multi-user mileage prices ($8/$12 per user/month) confirmed published on pricing-multi-user and corroborated by aggregators (G2, SpotSaaS); the 7-day Premium pass is a once-per-year sample, not a standard trial.

vendors.name: Driversnote
vendors.provenance: Re-fetched driversnote.com/pricing directly. Free plan confirmed at 15 trips/month. Pro confirmed at $11/month per driver. Teams confirmed at $11/license/month for 2-10 users. Teams+ (11+ users) is custom-quote (monthlyUsd null). No annual discount percentage; annual subscribers receive a free iBeacon ($40 value) instead of a price reduction.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 15 trips/month. Automatic tracking on iOS, Android, and web. Manual start/stop. Basic reporting.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $11/month per driver. Unlimited trips, unlimited reporting, edit log, public API. Annual subscribers receive a free iBeacon ($40 value). One license = one driver regardless of vehicle count.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: $11/license/month for 2-10 drivers. All Pro features plus web admin tools, report collection, and validation. Annual subscribers receive a free iBeacon per license.

plans.name: Teams+
plans.notes: 11+ employees. Custom pricing (contact sales). All Teams features plus SSO, personalized onboarding, dedicated customer success manager.

limits: Teams plan covers 2-10 users only; 11+ requires custom quote
keyFeatures: iBeacon for automatic trip detection without phone GPS drain
Web admin dashboard for team report collection and validation
IRS, HMRC, ATO, and CRA compliant log formats
enrichment.provenance: Re-fetched driversnote.com/pricing directly. No explicit annual discount percentage published; annual benefit is a free iBeacon device, not a price reduction. Teams+ is genuinely quote-only (monthlyUsd null).

vendors.name: Hurdlr
vendors.provenance: hurdlr.com/pricing live page shows no dollar amounts (verified). Premium confirmed at $9.99/month or $100/year ($8.34/mo) via Hurdlr University Premium help article and Capterra. Pro confirmed at $200/year, annual only, via Hurdlr University Pro article. No official source states a free trial, so freeTrialDays set to null. Free plan includes unlimited semi-automatic mileage tracking; fully automatic tracking is Premium-only.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Unlimited semi-automatic mileage tracking (fully automatic tracking is Premium-only). Manual income and expense tracking. Real-time tax estimates. No bank sync.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $9.99/month (monthly) or $100/year billed annually (~$8.34/month; ~17% vs $119.88). Adds automatic mileage tracking, automatic bank/card expense tracking, advanced reporting, real-time tax estimates.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $200/year billed annually only (no monthly option; ~$16.67/month equivalent). All Premium features plus annual federal + 1 state tax filing, invoicing, payment collection, advanced accounting, home office deduction tracking. Not available to enterprise/employer-provided accounts.

limits: Free plan: semi-automatic mileage only (no fully automatic tracking), no bank sync
Pro plan: annual billing only, not available on employer-provided accounts
Pro $200/year is annual-only; expressed as monthlyUsd null because no monthly price is published
keyFeatures: Real-time tax estimates based on income and expenses
Designed for self-employed / gig economy workers
bestFor: Freelancers tracking income, expenses, mileage, and taxes in one app
Gig workers wanting quarterly tax estimates
enrichment.provenance: Live hurdlr.com/pricing confirmed to show no dollar figures. Premium $9.99/mo and $100/yr verified via Hurdlr University Premium article; Pro $200/yr annual-only via Hurdlr University Pro article. Draft's claimed 7-day free trial removed (no official source confirms it). Free plan corrected to semi-automatic mileage tracking.

vendors.name: Stride
vendors.provenance: Re-fetched stridehealth.com/tax directly. The page states the app is free with no paid tiers. Mileage tracking, expense logging, tax deduction reports, and the health insurance marketplace are all included at no cost; revenue comes from insurance enrollment commissions.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Completely free, no paid tiers. Automatic mileage tracking with work-trip reminders, IRS-ready expense and mileage reports, deduction discovery, and health/dental/vision/life insurance marketplace. Revenue model is insurance referrals, not subscriptions.

limits: No published trip or feature caps; all features free
keyFeatures: Automatic mileage tracking with work-trip reminders
bestFor: Gig economy workers (rideshare, delivery) wanting zero-cost mileage tracking
Freelancers needing combined mileage + health insurance in one app
enrichment.provenance: Re-fetched stridehealth.com/tax directly. Confirmed fully free with no paid subscription tiers. Business model relies on insurance enrollment commissions.

vendors.name: Zoho Expense
vendors.provenance: Re-fetched the official US page zoho.com/us/expense/pricing/. It publishes month-to-month prices ($43 Standard / $65 Premium per user) and billed-annually per-month equivalents ($3 Standard / $5 Premium per user). The dataset uses the billed-annually equivalents (the headline prices Zoho markets). The draft's $4/$7 were incorrect annual figures and have been corrected to $3/$5. Free plan (3 users, GPS mileage) and 14-day trial confirmed.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 3 users. Expense reports, GPS mileage tracking, multi-currency, 5 GB receipt storage, 20 receipt autoscans/month, integrations with Zoho Books, QuickBooks Online, Xero.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $3/user/month billed annually ($43/user/month billed monthly). Minimum 3 users. Adds corporate card management, direct card feeds, multi-level approvals, split expenses, custom roles, cash advance, ACH reimbursements.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $5/user/month billed annually ($65/user/month billed monthly). Minimum 3 users. Adds online travel booking, travel desk management, GSA-compliant per diem, live mileage tracking, live budget tracking, itemized receipt autoscan, multi-entity/country management.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: Large organizations / 100+ users. Quote-only. Dedicated account manager, 24/7 priority support, custom integrations, SFTP exports, advanced SSO, IP whitelisting.

limits: Free plan limited to 3 users and 20 receipt autoscans/month
Standard and Premium require minimum 3 users
Custom plan requires large organizations / 100+ users (quote-only)
keyFeatures: 14-day free trial, no credit card required
bestFor: Mid-market businesses needing full expense + mileage + travel
Companies already in the Zoho ecosystem
Global teams needing multi-currency and multi-country support
enrichment.provenance: USD pricing re-verified directly on the official US page zoho.com/us/expense/pricing/: Standard $3/user/month (annual) / $43 (monthly); Premium $5/user/month (annual) / $65 (monthly). Draft's $4/$7 annual figures corrected to $3/$5. 'Save up to 25%' annual claim from the official page. Free plan 3 users and 14-day trial confirmed.
